title: Selection picks the best idea of a batch by the site's own criteria
description:
Requested by Humorus (HUM-b0d999). story_selection.py judges ideas against mission, policy, kill criteria and recency, one call per section. A satire site needs to pick the funniest idea of the day's batch. Add site-owned selection criteria (a guidelines document kind, publication and section scope; for satire, a humour rubric) and a batch mode: the selector compares the run's candidate Ideas against each other and the criteria, picks up to max-new-stories, and records for every candidate its reason and rank on the Idea, so editors see why one won. Machines never give 5 stars (rating policy).

Scenario: given 10 Ideas and a humour rubric, the selector picks 1, moves it to assignment as automation:idea-selection, and records a ranked reason on all 10. Scenario: an editor reverses the pick and promotes another. Scenario: a site with no criteria document selects exactly as today.
Standing rules: no workarounds, fallbacks or shims; Gherkin specs.
